name: EDCI 3213
title: Introduction to Secondary Methods and Clinic: Science
description: Pedagogical techniques in middle and high school science classroom settings, including setting student learning goals, planning and engaging students in activity that is authentic to the discipline of science, with an increased focus on facilitating productive small group and whole class task-based discourse in science classrooms.
requirement_description: Open only to secondary science education students in the Integrated Bachelor's/Master's Teacher Preparation Program.
